review_mode: Read-only full source review, exact comparison and AST validation. Candidate was not imported or executed. No original /app, UI, DB, network or Git mutation. Only this scratch JSON was written.
merge_input: Final M is required as a complete lowercase SHA through --deployment-sha when --build is selected. No final M is guessed or embedded.

checks.name: inactive_and_clean_preconditions
checks.evidence: Official inactive status with no incomplete lease directory is checked initially, immediately before FF, immediately before build and after build. Tracked/index/submodule cleanliness and reviewed branch/head gates are enforced.

checks.name: complete_reviewed_git_identity
checks.evidence: Checks fetched production equals supplied M, M and B tree equal reviewed tree, B parent exactly A, M parents exactly J and B, A ancestor and exact A-to-M intent-only path. Runtime intent must match A/R/protocol/branch.

checks.name: preserve_120_untracked
checks.evidence: Snapshots every untracked path by kind/mode/content hash, rejects unsafe path/parent symlink and snapshot races, requires count 120, and checks conflicts with target tracked tree. Preservation checked before FF/build and after build; no cleanup/restore/quarantine/deletion commands.

checks.name: append_only_sidecar
checks.evidence: Only .emergent/stripped_env_names may gain an appended suffix after build, preserving prior bytes, regular-file kind and mode. All other changes or deletions fail without restoration.

checks.name: github_markers
checks.evidence: GITHUB_ACTIONS/GITHUB_SHA/GITHUB_WORKSPACE cause a stop with names-only evidence. They are never removed from the copied child environment.

checks.name: actual_build
checks.evidence: Runs actual yarn build once in /app/frontend with timeout=None and public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://mezansalla.com. Saves stdout/stderr and actual child exit/timing before exit validation and before identity/preservation postconditions.

checks.name: runtime_and_source_after_build
checks.evidence: Requires materialized release_identity JSON exactly equal to reviewed intent, unchanged M head, tracked cleanliness, preservation and fresh inactive guard before outcome ready=True.

checks.name: no_lease_or_publication
checks.evidence: Only status is invoked through production_release_guard. No prepare/prepublish/verify/abort, publication, financial API or manual lease mutation is present.

checks.name: no_bytecode_cleanup
checks.evidence: Child Python uses -B/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE. Ignored backend bytecode causes a stop for separate review; the script never deletes cache files.

checks.name: evidence_and_buffers
checks.evidence: Evidence is created in a new private /tmp/mezan-pr1918-original-* directory with umask077. Filesystem hashes explicitly do not cover unsaved editor buffers; operator must inspect those separately.

provided_preflight.provenance: Root-recorded original-host/UI observations read from existing JSON; not independently repeated by reviewer.

remaining_operator_gates: B CI and final normal merge must complete before build; use the reviewed final M CLI value.
Fresh gates inside the helper must still pass when run; earlier preflight is not a substitute.
Preserve the observed Untitled-1 buffer; helper neither saves nor discards it.
A helper PASS is not a claim that build, publication or production acceptance has occurred.
timestamp_policy: Only the supplied preflight observation timestamp is retained; no helper execution timestamp is fabricated.
